title: Loudoun Phase 2 Data Center Standards and Locations Project — Phase 65 Northern Virginia large-load delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Northern Virginia large-load delivery reporting pack. Loudoun County's Phase 2 project records an approved work plan to consider data-center compatibility, special-exception review, operational needs, mitigation, and redevelopment.
key_findings: The Board of Supervisors approved the Phase 2 project plan on September 16, 2025.
The work is intended to evaluate compatibility issues through the special-exception process.
The active project is not adopted ordinance text or a facility-specific approval.
why_it_matters: Which records connect load forecasts, local land-use rules, utility decisions, transmission, environmental permits, water, service acceptance, and reliability? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The record makes local acceptance and land-use rules a traceable implementation gate.
ftfn_relevance: Adds the policy-development record to the corridor dossier.
Separates project planning from adopted and effective standards.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The page does not establish final Phase 2 text or an effective date.
It does not prove project compliance or community outcomes.
